## **The ROI of AI** runs through third-party apps

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6e2f07cb3410da71731102_Frame%201%20Graphic.avif)

### Your teams are shipping agentic apps every day.

Vibe-coded workflows connect straight into Salesforce, Snowflake, Workday, and Slack, often before anyone's reviewed them.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6e2f07970b8a10ed12a672_Frame%202%20Graphic.avif)

### Apps are talking to apps, and agents are joining the conversation.

App-to-app and agent-to-app connections are multiplying access paths and blast radius inside every third-party app you run.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6f5ccb13f05253e2dc379e_Frame%203%20Graphic.avif)

### Copilots are showing up inside every app your employees touch.

Built-in agents are already embedded in the third-party apps your team uses daily, with access and activity you haven't mapped yet.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6e2f07e64a3e5256e56709_Frame%204%20Graphic.avif)

### Agents are funded to act, not just answer.

Autonomous agents no longer summarizing. They are reading, writing, and executing workflows inside your third-party apps, mostly unreviewed.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6e2f075938f65f3d785b1a_Frame%205%20Graphic.avif)

### Frontier models are making agents smarter and more capable.

Newer, more capable models can reason, plan and act with far more autonomy. And just as easily, they can find and exploit gaps in third-party apps at machine speed.
